name: Ravencraft

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (silver wire); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.summary: At 0 HP it makes a Con save (DC 5 + damage) to stay at 1 HP, unless hit by Radiant or a Critical Hit.
traits.text: When damage drops the ravencraft to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken. On a success it drops to 1 Hit Point instead. It can't make this save if the damage was Radiant or came from a Critical Hit.

actions.name: Harbinger of Doom
actions.summary: Twice a day: one creature within 60 ft makes a DC 11 Wis save or takes 1d10 Psychic and is Frightened until the end of its next turn (half damage on a success).

reactions.name: Death Veil
reactions.trigger: A creature within 30 ft makes a Death Saving Throw.
reactions.summary: When a creature within 30 ft makes a Death Saving Throw, it has Advantage on the save.

summary: A stitched-together undead bird that pecks, wails dread at one foe, refuses to fall at first, and keeps dying heroes alive.
